**Dear Business Owner,**


Just like that, we’re at the beginning of the end of Q1! Time flies when you’re focused on building and growing, doesn’t it? As always, this is your reminder to take a step back, reassess your goals, and make sure you’re on track for the year ahead.


At Lenco, we’ve been making moves to support your business better, and February was no exception. Let’s take a look at what we’ve been up to!


## **A Month of Love & Connection**


We kicked off February by celebrating the heart of our business—you! Our love letters weren’t just words; they were a testament to how much we value your journey. Whether you’re a startup finding your footing or an established brand making waves, we’re honored to be part of your story.


## **Expanding Horizons: Lenco Launches Payments in Malawi!**


We believe business shouldn’t be limited by borders, which is why we’re thrilled to announce that Lenco has expanded into Malawi! Now, Zambian businesses can open a **Malawi-Kwacha account right from Zambia** , making cross-border payments smoother and more accessible than ever.


This means **faster transactions, lower costs, and easier operations for businesses trading between Zambia and Malawi** . If you’ve been considering expanding your business reach, now’s the perfect time to explore new opportunities!


**Let’s Grow Together**


At Lenco, we’re committed to providing you with the right tools, insights, and support to **navigate the business landscape with ease** . Whether it’s streamlining payments, keeping you informed about market trends, or helping you expand beyond borders, we’re always here to power your growth.


### Before You Go


We’ve got a little challenge for you! The first word you see in this puzzle will define your March. Let us know what you get!


**To growth and success,**
*The Lenco Team*
